description: A list page — FilterBar search, a Status facet and Mine | Team over the same records as a table or a grid of linked tiles, with Load more and three empty tiers.

 * Replace both with your own API.

/** One customer row. */
export interface Customer {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  city: string;
  industry: "Hospitality" | "Retail" | "Offices";
  owner: string;
  status: "Active" | "Prospect" | "Paused";
  projects: number;
  /** When the record last changed, as an ISO date. */
  updatedAt: string;
}
